IF(  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIR]))
  BEGIN
 select 1  
 end
 else
 select 0

INSERT into Policy.[LimitDeductibleSIRs] (
      [LimitDeductibleSIRKey]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRName]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDesc]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRFlag]
      ,[LinkLevelName]
      ,[PolicyLevelsCompoundId]
      ,[StartDate]
      ,[OriginalCurrencyKey]
      ,[SharedInd]
      ,[SplitInd]
      ,[CSLInd]
      ,[ALAEErodesInd]
      ,[ALAEIncludedInd]
      ,[StackedInd]
      ,[DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd]
      ,[ReplacementValueInd]
      ,[SourceSystemDateCreated]
      ,[SourceSystemDateModified]
      ,[EffectiveDate]
      ,[ExpirationDate]
      ,[SourceSystemId]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRCode]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRType]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailDesc]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRValueType]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRValue]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRCountUnitType]
      ,[PercentageResponsible]
      ,[ActualCashValueInd]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRInd]
      ,[WithinLayerInd]
      ,[BreachesLayerInd]
      ,[TrailingInd]
      ,[LoadDate]
      ,[InternalDataId]
      ,[BatchId]
      ,[LastModifiedBatchId]
      ,[LineageId]
      ,[BusinessKeyHash]
      ,[ContentHash]
      ,[DataVarInd]
      ,[DataVarIndDate]
	  ,LineKey
          )
select
      a.[LimitDeductibleSIRKey]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRName]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRDesc]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRFlag]
      ,a.[LinkLevelName]
      ,a.[PolicyLevelsCompoundId]
      ,a.[StartDate]
      ,a.[OriginalCurrencyKey]
      ,a.[SharedInd]
      ,a.[SplitInd]
      ,a.[CSLInd]
      ,a.[ALAEErodesInd]
      ,a.[ALAEIncludedInd]
      ,a.[StackedInd]
      ,a.[DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd]
      ,a.[ReplacementValueInd]
      ,a.[SourceSystemDateCreated]
      ,a.[SourceSystemDateModified]
      ,a.[EffectiveDate]
      ,a.[ExpirationDate]
      ,a.[SourceSystemId]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRCode]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRType]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailDesc]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRValueType]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRValue]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRCountUnitType]
      ,a.[PercentageResponsible]
      ,a.[ActualCashValueInd]
      ,a.[LimitDeductibleSIRInd]
      ,a.[WithinLayerInd]
      ,a.[BreachesLayerInd]
      ,a.[TrailingInd]
      ,a.[LoadDate]
      ,a.[InternalDataId]
      ,a.[BatchId]
      ,a.[LastModifiedBatchId]
      ,a.[LineageId]
      ,a.[BusinessKeyHash]
      ,a.[ContentHash]
      ,a.[DataVarInd]
      ,a.[DataVarIndDate]
	  ,a.LineKey
   

from Temp.[LimitDeductibleSIRs] a
 left join [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs] b    with(nolock)
  on a.LimitDeductibleSIRKey = b.LimitDeductibleSIRKey
  and a.startdate = b.StartDate
where
 b.LimitDeductibleSIRKey is null
 
;

Update [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs]   

   set   [LimitDeductibleSIRName]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRName] 
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDesc]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRDesc] 
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRFlag]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRFlag] 
      ,[LinkLevelName]  = SRC.[LinkLevelName] 
      ,[PolicyLevelsCompoundId]  = SRC.[PolicyLevelsCompoundId] 
         ,[OriginalCurrencyKey]  = SRC.[OriginalCurrencyKey] 
      ,[SharedInd]  = SRC.[SharedInd] 
      ,[SplitInd]  = SRC.[SplitInd] 
      ,[CSLInd]  = SRC.[CSLInd] 
      ,[ALAEErodesInd]  = SRC.[ALAEErodesInd] 
      ,[ALAEIncludedInd]  = SRC.[ALAEIncludedInd] 
      ,[StackedInd]  = SRC.[StackedInd] 
      ,[DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd]  = SRC.[DeductibleSIRErodesLimitInd] 
      ,[ReplacementValueInd]  = SRC.[ReplacementValueInd] 
      ,[SourceSystemDateCreated]  = SRC.[SourceSystemDateCreated] 
      ,[SourceSystemDateModified]  = SRC.[SourceSystemDateModified] 
      ,[EffectiveDate]  = SRC.[EffectiveDate] 
      ,[ExpirationDate]  = SRC.[ExpirationDate] 
    --  ,[EndDate]  = SRC.[EndDate] 
       -- ,[SourceSystemId]  = SRC.[SourceSystemId] 
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRCode]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRCode]  
  , [LimitDeductibleSIRType]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRType]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailDesc]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailDesc]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRValueType]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRValueType]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRValue]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRValue]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRCountUnitType]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRCountUnitType]
      ,[PercentageResponsible]  = SRC.[PercentageResponsible]
      ,[ActualCashValueInd]  = SRC.[ActualCashValueInd]
      ,[LimitDeductibleSIRInd]  = SRC.[LimitDeductibleSIRInd]
      ,[WithinLayerInd]  = SRC.[WithinLayerInd]
      ,[BreachesLayerInd]  = SRC.[BreachesLayerInd]
      ,[TrailingInd]  = SRC.[TrailingInd]
      ,[LastModifiedBatchId]  = SRC.BatchId
      ,[LineageId]  = SRC.[LineageId]
       ,[ContentHash]  = SRC.[ContentHash]
      ,[SourceSystemId]  = SRC.[SourceSystemId]
      ,[DataVarInd]  = SRC.[DataVarInd]
      ,[DataVarIndDate]  = SRC.[DataVarIndDate]
	  ,LineKey = SRC.LineKey
     -- ,[EndDate]  = SRC.[EndDate]
 FROM   Temp.[LimitDeductibleSIRs] AS [SRC]
   Where  [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs].LimitDeductibleSIRKey = SRC.LimitDeductibleSIRKey
   and  [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs].StartDate =SRC.StartDate	  
   and Policy.LimitDeductibleSIRs.[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName]=src.[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName]
      and 	  [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs].ContentHash <>SRC.ContentHash

Update Policy.[LimitDeductibleSIRs]
set EndDate = Enddate_UPD , [LastModifiedBatchId] = BTBATCHID
from (
SELECT [LimitDeductibleSIRName], LimitDeductibleSIRdetailName
,[BusinessKeyHash] -- ,LineStateCode
,startdate,bt.[BatchId] as BTBATCHID,EndDate_UPD=ISNULL(MAX(startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY BusinessKeyHash , [LimitDeductibleSIRName] ,LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName--- ,LineStateCode
ORDER BY startdate ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND 1 FOLLOWING),d.defaultdate)
FROM [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs]
,Control.DefaultDate d
    ,(select [BatchId]=max(batchid) from control.Batch) bt
)
U
where [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs].[LimitDeductibleSIRName]= U.[LimitDeductibleSIRName]
and Isnull([Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs].[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName],'NA')= Isnull(U.[LimitDeductibleSIRDetailName],'NA')
and [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs].[BusinessKeyHash]= U.[BusinessKeyHash]
and [Policy].[LimitDeductibleSIRs].startdate= U.startdate
  and EndDate <> Enddate_UPD 
;
